references.role: Inspected classic source for top-down orientation and industrial material language only; not copied into new art or tracked in Git
Iron Coast style reference, new boss uses a distinctly wider twin-turret silhouette

projectile_revision: First shell was too slender at 8x8 SD. v2 broadens the body and uses square framing; only v2 supplies runtime art.
pipeline: build_assets.py preserves generated RGBA, resizes full boss canvas, contains shell canvas with padding, derives BOX SD and LANCZOS HD; no redraw or alpha reconstruction.
alpha: Alpha preserved; engine uses alpha>=128 as indexed visibility. No outline or ground shadow added.
sounds: Three deterministic, original synthesized 22050 Hz mono PCM16 WAVs; exact recipe and hashes in audio-recipe.json.
version_control: All generated masters, shipped SD/HD PNGs, previews, prompts and WAVs intended for Git. Classic reference pixels remain outside this package.
